meta.title: Steering: reading is not writing
meta.notes: Injecting directions into the residual stream at one layer (last prompt position + generated steps only; strength = fraction of the position's residual norm; direction centered by mean-row subtraction or explicit contrast). The Jacobian-transposed direction J^T w never steers - at every layer and strength it derails into junk-magnet output. Direct injection of the centered unembedding direction flips the answer at late layers. The corpus-average Jacobian is a good reader and a bad writer. Replication on dense Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: direct injection flips cleanly at the last fitted layer (L22 x0.15 -> ' Rome'); jacobian transport CAN flip there but needs ~2x the strength and yields degenerate repetition - the asymmetry is graded and appears to grow with scale/sparsity.

prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.

own own own own own own own own
